channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Serverless Storage on Amazon EMR Serverless now supports terabyte-scale shuffle
item.description: Amazon EMR Serverless now offers enhanced serverless storage capabilities with support for up to 1TB shuffle operations, raising the previous 200 GB per-job limit. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Improve your secrets security posture with actionable recommendations in the AWS Secrets Manager console
item.description: ​​​AWS Secrets Manager now integrates with the AWS Recommended Actions framework to surface contextual, actionable suggestions for your secrets directly in the Secrets Manager console. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon S3 Tables now support up to 100 table buckets per AWS Region in an AWS account
item.description: Amazon S3 Tables now support up to 100 table buckets per AWS Region in an AWS account, increased from 10. This allows you to create up to 1 million tables per AWS Region in an AWS account. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances adds support for NVIDIA Blackwell GPU
item.description: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances now supports Graphics G7 instances, powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs and Intel Xeon 6 processors. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS CLI now supports bulk skill updates and version checks for the Agent Toolkit for AWS
item.description: Today, AWS expanded the AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) commands for the Agent Toolkit for AWS with two new capabilities that make it easier to keep agent skills up to date. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon S3 Vectors introduces metadata pre-filtering for up to 5x higher recall on filtered search
item.description: Amazon S3 Vectors now supports pre-filtering, which evaluates metadata filters before running similarity search, returning up to 5x more of the matching vectors when your filter is selective. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Qt 6.12 LTS Released
item.description: As a Long-Term Support (LTS) release, Qt 6.12 is a culmination of various efforts on cybersecurity, UI performance, and much more across the tech stack. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: django-modern-rest@0.16.0 release
item.description: Hi everyone, I am the release manager of django-modern-rest :) django-modern-rest 0.16.0 is out! Is this your first time that you hear about this project? (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Qualcomm Unveils Linux Preview on Snapdragon X2 to Accelerate Upstream ARM Laptops
item.description: Qualcomm has released an early dev preview of Linux for its upcoming Snapdragon X2 Series laptop processors. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Pidgin 3.0 Alpha 3 2.97.0 has been released
item.description: We are ecstatic to announce that we have released the third alpha version of Pidgin 3.0!!! This release has an official version number of 2.97.0. We will continue releasing in this fashion until we are ready for 3.0.0 wh… (1 source: lobsters)
